component.name: Lexicon
component.summary: Local-first grammar and AI writing assistant

description.p: Lexicon is a writing editor with proofreading and AI rewrites that run on your computer by default.

ul.li: LanguageTool checks grammar and spelling locally. Proofreading works without an AI model.
An optional local AI model powers rewrites after you choose to download it.
Lexicon can also use an Ollama or LM Studio server that you configure.
A companion browser extension sends text to the local Lexicon app for checks in web pages.

description.p: There is no account and no Lexicon cloud document service. Model downloads and servers that you configure may use the network.
